violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PIC PURCHASED FOOD THERMOMETER DURING. INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Windows or doors kept open for ventilation or other purposes do not have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents. OBSERVED GARAGE DOOR OPEN DURING INSPECTION AND AIR CURTAIN NOT INSTALLED YET (FACILITY HAS THE AIR CURTAIN ONSITE, BUT NEEDS TO BE INSTALLED).
violations.corrective_action: Windows or doors kept open for ventilation or other purposes shall have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents by 1) 16 mesh to 25.4mm (16 mesh to 1 inch) screens; 2) properly designed and installed air curtains to control flying insects; or 3) other effective means. EHS REQUESTED FACILITY TO CLOSE GARAGE FOR THE TIME-BEING. PLEASE ENSURE THE GARAGE REMAINS CLOSED UNTIL THE AIR CURTAIN HAS BEEN INSTALLED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: OBSERVED FRIGIDAIRE CHEST FRIDGE AND FREEZER BEING USED TO STORE PRETZELS, PRE-PACKAGED CHARCUTERIE, AND FROZEN PIZZAS.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. ADVISED TO DISCONTINUE USING BOTH CHEST FRIDGE/FREEZER. PLEASE CONTACT THE ADMINISTRATIVE TEAM TO SUBMIT AN AMENDMENT FOR NSF- APPROVED EQUIPMENT.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly: OBSERVED HIGH HEAT DISHWASHING MACHINE MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 153.5F.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PLEASE ENSURE THE DISHWASHING MACHINE IS REPAIRED AND CAN MEET 160F AT A MINIMUM. THE FACILITY WILL ENSURE DISHWARE IS SANITIZED AT THREE-VAT SINK UNTIL THE DISHWASHING MACHINE IS REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Thermometer for Manual Wash & Sanitizing Temps
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO HIGH HEAT THERMOMETER-DISC OR TEST STRIPS FOR DISHWASHING MACHINE ONSITE DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: In manual warewashing operations, a temperature measuring device shall be provided and readily accessible for frequently measuring the washing and sanitizing temperatures. PIC PLACED ORDER FOR TEST STRIPS DURING INSPECTION.
